title: Cozy Halloween Pumpkin Patch Coaster Bundle, Autumn Designs (Digital Download)
description:
A warm, welcoming autumn quartet for coasters and sublimation: the Deadwood Station steam train rolling in under a full moon, a glowing jack-o'-lantern pyramid with a watchful crow, a lantern-lit trick-or-treat path through the pumpkin patch, and a cozy front porch decked out for Halloween with a black cat in the window.

✦ WHAT YOU GET
• 4 separate high-resolution PNG files (2400 x 2400 px, 300 DPI)
• Ready for sublimation coasters, UV DTF printing, tumblers, and more
• Instant digital download — no physical item is shipped

✦ DESIGN NOTES
Glowing jack-o'-lanterns, string lights, and autumn leaves give this set a friendly, welcoming Halloween feel that's great for fall decor and trick-or-treat season.

✦ AI DISCLOSURE
These designs were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools as part of my creative process, then hand-curated, cleaned up, and prepared for print. This listing is a digital file only; no physical product is shipped.

✦ USAGE
For personal use and small-batch commercial use on physical items you make and sell (coasters, tumblers, apparel, etc.). Resale or redistribution of the digital files themselves is not permitted.

Thank you for shopping Dragon Oak Studio!
